newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Golf-Woods starts his challenge in Australian Masters.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golf-Woods starts his challenge in Australian Masters.

text.p: American golf sensation Tiger Woods has teed off in pursuit of first round leader Lucas Parsons at the A$750,000 Australian Masters tournament at Huntingdale.
Woods, the overwhelming favourite, was on level par after three holes, eight shots adrift of Australian Parsons, who has played 13 holes.
New Zealander Simon Owens is second on the leaderboard at five under par after 17 holes.
